promises.name: pending-reaction
promises.source: var reference, seen, fulfill; var promise = new Promise(resolve => { fulfill = resolve; }); (() => { const target = { value: 7 }; reference = new WeakRef(target); promise.then(() => { seen = target.value; }); })();

promises.name: promise-all-accumulator
promises.source: var reference, seen, fulfill, aggregate; var promise = new Promise(resolve => { fulfill = resolve; }); (() => { const target = { value: 7 }; reference = new WeakRef(target); aggregate = Promise.all([target, promise]); })(); aggregate.then(values => { seen = values[0].value; });
